newsitem.title: UK: Dollar/mark rises to 39-month high in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Dollar/mark rises to 39-month high in Europe.

text.p: The dollar rose to its highest level against the German mark in since February 1994, topping the previous 1997 high at 1.7389 marks after a robust rise in U.S. non-farm jobs in May, dealers said.
The dollar rose to a new high at 1.7415 by 1231 GMT compared with 1.7380/85 just before the employment report and a close in Europe late Thursday at 1.7292/97.
Chartists said there is now scope to rise to initial resistance at 1.7500 and then the 1994 high at 1.7686.
U.S. non-farm payrolls rose a smaller-than-expected 138,000 during May but April jobs were revised up sharply. Analysts polled by Reuters had expected a 219,000 rise in payrolls during the month.
